seo.title: Add Page Numbers to a PDF — Free & Secure | JPdf
seo.description: Add page numbers to every page of a PDF. Choose the position and starting number. Free, fast, and private.

subtitle: Number every page of a PDF file.

howItWorks.title: How to add page numbers to a PDF
steps: Upload the PDF file you want to number.
Choose where the number should appear and what number to start at.
Click Add page numbers and download the result.

items.a: Yes, adding page numbers is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Can I choose where the numbers appear?
items.a: Yes, pick any corner or the center of the top or bottom margin.

items.q: Can I start numbering from a number other than 1?
items.a: Yes, set any starting number and each following page increases by one.
